CREATE TABLE live_control_evidence (
	event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	key_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sequence_number BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	profile VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	packet_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	key_reference VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL, 
	accepted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (event_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_live_evidence_identity UNIQUE (device_id, key_epoch, sequence_number)
)
